items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clifford Brown, well... I can’t remember them all of course, but you can read about it.

ctx.x: How long did your stay at Birdland last?

I wonder, it seems like years. It seemed like my entire musical education. I saw everyone from Count Basie, almost weekly, to... I even saw Lester Young there. The only person I never saw there was Charlie Parker. Everybody else I saw there. Clifford Brown, well... I can’t remember them all of course, but you can read about it.
Was it Clifford with Max, or was it pre-Max?
